title: VmRecord
description: Catalog VM with configuration revision and last persisted state.

config_revision.description: Configuration revision, incremented on every change (revision check).

persisted_state.description: Last persisted state: a hint, the observed state takes precedence.

Firmware.description: Guest firmware. In the MVP only UEFI with managed NVRAM state (ROADMAP 8).

GuestOs.description:
Declared guest operating system. In the MVP the reference is Ubuntu LTS
x86_64 with the version and checksum pinned in F0 (ROADMAP 4).

oneOf.description: Other Linux x86_64: manageable manually, without compatibility guarantees.

MediaId.description: MediaId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

NetworkProfile.description:
Network profile. In the MVP the only allowed value is `offline` (ADR-0004): no
guest NIC, default network devices excluded, no forwarding.

UtcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z suffix, millisecond precision.

VmConfig.description:
VM configuration requested by the user. No field is a path or
a QEMU option: media are referenced by [`MediaId`] of the approved registry.

data_media.description: Optional read-only data media (kind `data_iso`), attached with the VM off.

disk_gib.description: Virtual size of the main QCOW2 disk in GiB.

install_media.description: Installation media from the media registry (kind `install_iso`).

limits.description:
Execution limits applied by the supervisor to the QEMU process
(ADR-0017); missing in older catalogs → default values.

memory_mib.description: Guest memory in MiB (not the limit of the whole QEMU process).

network.description: Network profile; in the MVP only `offline`.

vcpus.description: Number of vCPUs (not a CPU percentage limit: ROADMAP 7.2).

VmId.description: VmId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

VmLimits.description:
Execution limits of a VM (ADR-0017), set by the user in the
VM settings and applied by the supervisor, never by the client.

cpu_max_percent.description:
CPU cap as a percentage of the capacity of the assigned vCPUs
([`MIN_CPU_MAX_PERCENT`]..=100; 100 = no cap). Applied by the
operating system to the whole QEMU process.

memory_margin_mib.description:
Memory granted to the QEMU process beyond the guest RAM, in MiB
([`MIN_MEMORY_MARGIN_MIB`]..=[`MAX_MEMORY_MARGIN_MIB`]). When the
limit is exceeded, QEMU is terminated and the exit is classified as a resource limit.

storage_budget_gib.description:
Maximum space in GiB for the VM's files beyond the main disk
(overlays, baselines, firmware variables); `None` = no dedicated budget.
Checked at every start.

VmName.description: VM name: ASCII label, not a path.

oneOf.description: Process absent and files released. The only state for operations on disks, NVRAM and media.
Spawn started, new `run_id` assigned, QMP not ready yet.
Stop requested; complete only once the process end is observed.
Start error or unexpected exit. No automatic promotion to baseline.
Reconciliation after a crash (journal, files, processes): no external mutation.
